businesses.business: health savings account custodian and benefits administration

offering_description.value: Provides custodial services and platforms for health savings accounts (HSAs), plus FSA, HRA, COBRA and commuter benefit administration. Serves employers, health plans, brokers and individual account holders. Earns money from custodial, interchange and service fees, and offers investment options to members.

primary_products.value: health savings accounts; investment platform for HSA balances; benefits debit cards

primary_services.value: HSA custodial services; consumer-directed benefit administration (FSA, HRA, COBRA, commuter); member education and support

customer_segment.value: B2B: employers, health plans, benefits brokers and benefit administrators; B2C: individual account holders and employees using HSAs

end_markets.value: healthcare benefits; employee benefits administration; financial services; retirement and savings

revenue_model.value: service fees: monthly account and administration fees from employers, plans and members; transaction or usage fees: interchange fees on card purchases; interest or premiums: custodial cash balances placed with banks and interest on deposits; commissions or management fees: investment fees on member HSA investments
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees; interest or premiums; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: HSA custodian holding member funds, working with employers, health plans and partner banks; service provider: administers consumer-directed benefits for employers and plans

geography_served.value: US national: Members and employers across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: HSA custody, FSA/HRA, COBRA and commuter benefit administration, and investments

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to employers and benefit consultants; partners / resellers: health plans and benefits partners offering HSAs to their clients; online: member enrollment through online portal and mobile app

regulatory_exposure.value: high: HSA non-bank custodian regulated by IRS and Treasury rules, also ERISA, DOL, HIPAA and CFPB oversight
